channel.title: AutoThinkers

item.title: The Attention Budget: Why Deep Thinkers Treat Focus Like Capital
item.description: Most knowledge work fails not from lack of intelligence, but from bankrupt attention. Here is a practical operating system for protecting cognitive capital.

item.title: Lattice Thinking: How to Connect Ideas Without Drowning in Notes
item.description: A practical method for building a personal idea lattice — the missing structure between scattered notes and genuine insight.

item.title: Designing Personal Systems That Survive Contact With Real Weeks
item.description: Most personal operating systems die by Wednesday. Here is how to design workflows that bend under load instead of shattering.
